cat > /root/run_eval_adaptive.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base
export HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com

MODEL=/root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/output/models/batchsize16_nmin8_seed42/final
OUTDIR=/root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/output/eval

echo "=== Starting eval at $(date) ==="

echo "--- HellaSwag 10-shot ---"
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 lm_eval --model hf \
  --model_args pretrained=$MODEL,dtype=bfloat16 \
  --tasks hellaswag --num_fewshot 10 --batch_size auto \
  --output_path $OUTDIR/qwen_adaptive_hellaswag

echo "--- ARC-Easy 25-shot ---"
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 lm_eval --model hf \
  --model_args pretrained=$MODEL,dtype=bfloat16 \
  --tasks arc_easy --num_fewshot 25 --batch_size auto \
  --output_path $OUTDIR/qwen_adaptive_arc_easy

echo "--- PIQA 5-shot ---"
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 lm_eval --model hf \
  --model_args pretrained=$MODEL,dtype=bfloat16 \
  --tasks piqa --num_fewshot 5 --batch_size auto \
  --output_path $OUTDIR/qwen_adaptive_piqa

echo "--- WinoGrande 5-shot ---"
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 lm_eval --model hf \
  --model_args pretrained=$MODEL,dtype=bfloat16 \
  --tasks winogrande --num_fewshot 5 --batch_size auto \
  --output_path $OUTDIR/qwen_adaptive_winogrande

echo "=== All done at $(date) ==="
EOF
chmod +x /root/run_eval_adaptive.sh
